functions.name: batch-enrich-people
functions.description: Submit a bounded native batch of people for asynchronous enrichment and profile-list association. Return submission acceptance, not completed contact results.

email.description: Known email identifying the person; provider warns of lower match success than other identifiers.

phone.description: Additional E.164 or internationally formatted phone matching information; not used alone as a batch identifier.

metadata.description: Per-person JSON metadata to associate with the lookup. Null is explicitly sent, omission sends nothing, and {} remains an explicit empty object.

npiNumber.description: Additional opaque healthcare NPI matching identifier; not used alone as a batch identifier.

lookupType.description: Classic lookup product; default standard when omitted. Not allowed in Universal batches.

enrichments.description: Universal categories to purchase for this person; at least one is required on every Universal item and unavailable on classic items.

linkedinUrl.description: LinkedIn profile URL identifying the person.

currentEmployer.description: Current employer name, paired with name.

items.description: One person identified by a profile ID, LinkedIn URL, email, or name and current employer.

people.description: People to enrich, preserving request order. Classic accepts 1–100; Universal accepts 10–100. Each item must identify a person and select a product appropriate to the billing model.

webhookId.description: Existing RocketReach lookup-webhook ID for result delivery. Omit only if the account already has an enabled webhook for this endpoint; this tool does not create one.

creditSystem.description: Account billing model for the whole batch; Universal is unavailable on Essentials, Pro, and Ultimate.

profileListName.description: Profile-list name to add the looked-up people to when complete. Default is API Bulk Lookup; the list association is an actual side effect.

FunctionInput_rocketreach_batchenrichpeo.description: One bounded asynchronous enrichment batch using an existing result-delivery webhook.

accepted.description: RocketReach accepted the batch request; this does not establish any person's match, completion, or success.

requestId.description: Provider RR-Request-ID header when returned, usable to correlate result webhook delivery; omitted if absent.

submittedCount.description: Number of queries submitted, derived from the input, not a provider success count.

profileListName.description: Requested destination profile-list name, not proof that every person has already been added.

FunctionOutput_rocketreach_batchenrichpe.description: Aggregate submission acceptance only; enrichment results arrive asynchronously.

tags.instructions: Use to start many paid enrichments when the account already has an enabled lookup webhook or you know an existing webhook ID. This does not create notification infrastructure. Classic accepts 1–100 people; Universal accepts 10–100, each with at least one enrichment category. Use `get-person` for fewer Universal targets. Results arrive through the existing webhook; for known person IDs you can also use `batch-get-person-lookup-statuses`. Submission acceptance is not per-person success. Do not blindly replay an uncertain submission.

functions.name: search-companies
functions.description: Find one page of company matches using identity, industry, location, financial, technology, intent, growth, and business-signal criteria.

order.description: Provider result ordering. Popularity prioritizes the provider's popularity ranking; score preserves its distinct ordering.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation from a previous identical search. Omit to start at the first result.

growth.description: Department growth comparisons over named provider reporting windows.

window.description: Provider growth reporting window, not an instant or arbitrary duration.

maximumPercentage.description: Maximum growth percentage, not less than the minimum.

minimumPercentage.description: Minimum growth percentage; negative values represent decline.

items.description: One department growth comparison over a named reporting window.

signals.description: Company business-event filters; category names must be supported by RocketReach for the selected type.

window.description: Provider-defined lookback window for the event.

category.description: Signal category, for example Funding, 10-K Filing, Accounting Roles, Patent Grant, Pricing Concerns, Traffic Surge, or Product Launch.

items.description: One business-event category and lookback window.

criteria.description: Company facets to match. Different facets combine using provider search semantics. Omitted or empty means no facet restrictions.

field.description: Company facet to search. Intent topics require an eligible plan; keyword variants retain the provider's distinct search modes.

exact.description: Request a quoted exact search term rather than provider fuzzy matching.

value.description: Ordinary facet text or opaque identifier, without provider quoting or exclusion prefixes.

exclude.description: Exclude matches to this term instead of including them.

publiclyTraded.description: Filter for publicly traded or non-public companies; omission applies no public-status filter.

numericCriteria.description: Financial or employee-count comparisons. Units remain the provider's native units because currency and reporting period are undocumented.

value.description: Comparison value, or lower bound for between.

operator.description: Comparison operator; between includes the supplied lower and upper endpoints according to provider range semantics.

upperValue.description: Upper bound, required only for between.

FunctionInput_rocketreach_searchcompanie.description: Company search criteria, billing model, and one-page continuation options.

id.description: Opaque RocketReach company ID usable with get-company.

logoUrl.description: Company logo URL when supplied by Universal search.

exact.description: Request an exact quoted term rather than provider fuzzy matching.

value.description: Ordinary text or an opaque identifier, without provider quoting or exclusion prefixes.

exclude.description: Exclude this term rather than including it.

items.description: One ordinary term with explicit matching and exclusion options.

terms.description: Terms for this facet, merged for repeated facet entries.

functions.name: verify-email
functions.description: Check whether one email address can receive mail and return the provider's deliverability status, component checks, MX host, and verification credits charged.

email.description: Address text to verify, at most 254 characters. Malformed nonempty addresses are allowed so the provider can return its format check; do not pre-encode it.

FunctionInput_rocketreach_verifyemail.description: One supplied email address to verify.

formatValid.description: Whether address formatting is valid; null if not checked.

domainValid.description: Whether the address domain accepts mail; null if not checked.

disposable.description: Whether the provider is disposable or high-risk; null if not checked.

catchall.description: Whether the domain accepts any address, independently of confirmed mailbox validity; null if not checked.

checks.description: Individual checks behind the status; null means the check did not run.

status.description: valid means the mailbox accepts mail; invalid includes malformed, disposable, risky, or non-accepting addresses; catchall means this mailbox could not be confirmed on an accept-all domain; unknown means deliverability could not be determined.

mxRecord.description: Primary MX hostname, or null when absent, unresolved, no domain exists, or lookup did not run. Null alone does not establish nondeliverability.

creditsCharged.description: Email-verification credits consumed: normally one, zero for unknown or incorrectly formatted results because these are refunded.

FunctionOutput_rocketreach_verifyemail.description: Provider deliverability classification, component checks, MX hostname, and actual verification credit charge.

tags.instructions: Use to check one supplied email address, not to find a person's email. Use `get-person` for contact enrichment. Verification normally costs one email-verification credit; unknown and incorrectly formatted results are refunded. A valid result can coexist with checks.catchall=true, and a null MX record alone does not prove invalidity. This does not send a user-composed message or guarantee future delivery. Maximum input length is 254 characters.
